title: Lone Star Doxie Talk - Episode 12
hook: Pull up a chair and sit a spell.   I'm Charlie and this here's Lone Star Doxie Talk. October is one of my favorite months of the year because I really love Halloween!
key_points: Charlie's Halloween costume search and try-on montage culminating in Spooky Dracula
Return to studio in Dracula costume with Breast Cancer Awareness Month poster in background
Thank you to CTDR community for the Summertime Fundraiser supporting medical care, boarding, spay/neuter, and heartworm treatment
CTDR 2027 Wall Calendar orders at ctdr.org
4th Annual Wienerfest hosted by Zilkerbark on Oct 31, 2026 at Sherwood Forest Faire in McDade, TX
October Breast Cancer Awareness Month: 'Every story is unique, every journey matters', early detection, and checkups
September 2026 Happy Tails adoption stories (held pending receipt of dog bios and pictures)
Episode wrap-up, volunteer/donation/adoption call to action, and Charlie's signature sign-off
core_message: Celebrate October with rescue milestones, Halloween costume fun, community Wienerfest anticipation, and vital breast cancer awareness advocacy.
cta: Visit ctdr.org to order your 2027 calendar, foster, adopt, or donate, get Wienerfest tickets at zilkerbark.com, and schedule your health checkups.

metadata.mandatory_closing_anchor: Until next time, remember, a rescued heart never forgets.
